key.name: layout
key.summary: Taskbar layout
key.description: “sections” splits the taskbar into one even-width lane per workspace. “list” is a single window list with a workspace switcher.

key.name: grouping-mode
key.summary: When to group windows
key.description: Decides when to group windows from the same application. Possible values are “never”, “auto” and “always”.

key.name: display-all-workspaces
key.summary: Show windows from all workspaces
key.description: In the window list layout, whether to show windows from all workspaces or only the current one.

key.name: show-workspace-numbers
key.summary: Show a number badge at the start of each workspace lane

key.name: color-workspaces
key.summary: Colour-code workspaces
key.description: Give each workspace its own colour across its lane or band, window buttons, previews and switcher thumbnails.

key.name: taskbar-colors-light
key.summary: How strongly to colour the taskbar's lanes and window buttons, in light style
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “off”, “subtle”, “medium” or “strong”.

key.name: taskbar-colors-dark
key.summary: How strongly to colour the taskbar's lanes and window buttons, in dark style
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “off”, “subtle”, “medium” or “strong”.

key.name: preview-colors-light
key.summary: How strongly to colour the hover preview and switcher thumbnails, in light style
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “off”, “subtle”, “medium” or “strong”.

key.name: preview-colors-dark
key.summary: How strongly to colour the hover preview and switcher thumbnails, in dark style
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “off”, “subtle”, “medium” or “strong”.

key.name: top-bar-color-light
key.summary: How strongly to colour the top bar with the current workspace's colour, in light style
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “off”, “subtle”, “medium” or “strong”.

key.name: top-bar-color-dark
key.summary: How strongly to colour the top bar with the current workspace's colour, in dark style
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “off”, “subtle”, “medium” or “strong”.

key.name: background-colors-light
key.summary: How saturated the workspace backgrounds are, in light style
key.description: Only when workspace backgrounds are on. “off” shows the wallpaper as it is; “strong” is the most saturated.

key.name: background-colors-dark
key.summary: How saturated the workspace backgrounds are, in dark style
key.description: Only when workspace backgrounds are on. “off” shows the wallpaper as it is; “strong” is the most saturated.

key.name: match-accent-color
key.summary: Set GNOME's accent colour to the current workspace's
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. Your own accent colour is saved and put back when this is off.

key.name: workspace-backgrounds
key.summary: A background per workspace in its colour
key.description: Only when colour coding is on. “recolor” shows the wallpaper in each workspace's colour, “gradient” a gradient of it. Shown on the desktop, in the overview and while switching workspaces.

key.name: light-shell
key.summary: Light top bar and menus in Light style
key.description: GNOME's top bar, menus and overview normally stay dark even when GNOME Settings is set to Light. With this on they follow it.

key.name: saved-accent-color
key.summary: The user's own accent colour, while it is being overridden

key.name: workspace-colors
key.summary: Workspace colours
key.description: Colours (#rrggbb) for workspaces 1, 2, 3 and so on. Missing or empty entries use the default palette.

key.name: minimize-on-click
key.summary: Minimize the focused window when its button is clicked
key.description: When off, clicking the button of the window that already has focus does nothing.

key.name: show-on-all-monitors
key.summary: Show the taskbar on all monitors

key.name: embed-previews
key.summary: Show workspace previews in the window list layout’s switcher

key.name: preview-delay
key.summary: Hover delay before showing a workspace preview, in milliseconds
